title: Weakly supervised deep learning predicts perineural invasion from H&E whole-slide images in tongue squamous cell carcinoma: development and external validation.
source: PubMed · International journal of medical informatics
zh_title: 弱监督深度学习从H&E全切片预测舌鳞癌神经侵犯
summary: 两中心回顾性研究开发弱监督全切片模型预测舌鳞癌神经侵犯，并在独立外部队列验证。

以患者层面划分数据，任务为神经侵犯预测

abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] Perineural invasion (PNI) in tongue squamous cell carcinoma (TSCC) is associated with aggressive behavior and poor outcomes, yet it can be under-recognized on H&E sections because it is often focal and interpretation varies. Manual assessment of PNI suffers from significant interobserver variability, motivating AI-based decision support. We developed and externally validated a weakly supervised WSI model to predict PNI in TSCC. We retrospectively analyzed 1,511 digitized H&E whole-slide images from 629 patients at two centers. Patient-level partitioning yielded an internal training cohort of 305 patients and 787 WSIs, an internal validation cohort of 132 patients and 340 WSIs, and an external test cohort of 192 patients and 384 WSIs. Non-overlapping tiling generated 41,552,500 candidate patches before tissue-background exclusion, of which 7,813,555 unique tissue patches were retained for analysis. A two-stage pipeline was used: patch-level modeling and MIL-based slide aggregation. ResNet50 was selected over Inception_v3 and SimpleViT as the feature extractor. Patch-level prediction probabilities and image features were aggregated into a 101-dimensional patch likelihood histogram (PLH) and a 101-dimensional visual bag-of-words (BoW) representation, respectively. For conventional classifiers, the two representations were concatenated into a 202-dimensional vector, followed by z-score normalization and LASSO feature selection. For the Transformer, the two representations were processed separately using PCA, independently projected into 128-dimensional embedding spaces, and integrated using four-head cross-attention. Performance was assessed by ROC, decision curve analysis (DCA), and calibration. The internal training, internal validation, and external test cohorts included 305, 132, and 192 patients, respectively. PNI prevalence was 82.3%, 79.5%, and 72.9% in these cohorts, respectively. The Transformer fusion model achieved AUCs of 0.990 in the training cohort, 0.968 in the internal validation cohort, and 0.940 in the external test cohort. Calibration and decision curve analysis were used to characterize the model's predicted probabilities and modeled net benefit in the retrospective study cohorts. Patch-level Grad-CAM was used to generate qualitative saliency visualisations associated with ResNet50 patch-level PNI scores. This externally validated computational pathology application demonstrated retrospective technical feasibility for WSI-level PNI predicti
zh_abstract: [International journal of medical informatics] 舌鳞状细胞癌（TSCC）中的神经周围侵犯（PNI）与侵袭性行为和不良结局相关，但由于其常为局灶性且判读存在差异，在 H&E 切片上可能被低估。PNI 的人工评估存在显著的观察者间变异，促使采用基于 AI 的决策支持。我们开发并外部验证了一种弱监督 WSI 模型，用于预测 TSCC 中的 PNI。我们回顾性分析了来自两个中心 629 名患者的 1,511 张数字化 H&E 全切片图像（WSI）。患者水平划分得到内部训练队列 305 名患者和 787 张 WSI、内部验证队列 132 名患者和 340 张 WSI，以及外部测试队列 192 名患者和 384 张 WSI。非重叠切块在排除组织-背景前生成 41,552,500 个候选图像块，其中保留 7,813,555 个唯一组织图像块用于分析。采用两阶段流程：图像块级建模和基于 MIL 的切片聚合。选择 ResNet50 而非 Inception_v3 和 SimpleViT 作为特征提取器。图像块级预测概率和图像特征分别聚合为 101 维图像块似然直方图（PLH）和 101 维视觉词袋（BoW）表示。对于传统分类器，两种表示拼接为 202 维向量，随后进行 z-score 归一化和 LASSO 特征选择。对于 Transformer，两种表示分别使用 PCA 处理，独立投影到 128 维嵌入空间，并使用四头交叉注意力进行整合。通过 ROC、决策曲线分析（DCA）和校准评估性能。内部训练、内部验证和外部测试队列分别包括 305、132 和 192 名患者。这些队列中 PNI 患病率分别为 82.3%、79.5% 和 72.9%。Transformer 融合模型在训练队列、内部验证队列和外部测试队列中分别达到 AUC 0.990、0.968 和 0.940。使用校准和决策曲线分析来表征模型在回顾性研究队列中的预测概率和建模净获益。使用图像块级 Grad-CAM 生成与 ResNet50 图像块级 PNI 评分相关的定性显著性可视化。这项经外部验证的计算病理学应用在回顾性研究中证明了 WSI 水平 PNI 预测的技术可行性

title: Artificial intelligence for cerebrovascular digital subtraction angiography: methods, evidence, and challenges.
source: PubMed · Physics in medicine and biology
zh_title: 脑血管数字减影血管造影AI方法、证据与挑战综述
summary: 该结构式主题综述汇总AI在2D、三维旋转及4D DSA脑血管图像分析中的方法、证据与验证差异。
key_points: 覆盖2D DSA、3D旋转造影与4D DSA

abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] Cerebrovascular diseases remain a major cause of mortality and long-term disability worldwide. Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) provides high-spatiotemporal-resolution visualization of cerebrovascular anatomy and contrast-agent dynamics and plays an important role in diagnosis, interventional treatment planning, and treatment assessment. Artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly been applied to cerebrovascular DSA, yet the available evidence is distributed across diverse imaging settings, technical tasks, datasets, and validation strategies. This structured topical review provides a DSA-centered overview of AI-assisted cerebrovascular image analysis across 2D DSA, three-dimensional rotational angiography, and four-dimensional DSA. Literature from Web of Science Core Collection and major engineering databases was screened at title, abstract, and full-text levels using predefined eligibility criteria. The literature is organized around six interconnected tasks: image preprocessing, vessel and lesion segmentation, image registration, reconstruction and generation, disease diagnosis and detection, and hemodynamic analysis. Representative conventional and learning-based methods are reviewed together with their datasets, evaluation metrics, validation designs, and available data or code resources, with particular attention to the strength and limitations of the supporting evidence. Recent studies demonstrate increasing use of spatiotemporal modeling, deep learning, and image-generation techniques, but clinical translation remains constrained by small or single-center datasets, heterogeneous acquisition protocols and evaluation practices, limited external and prospective validation, model interpretability, and deployment requirements. Future work should emphasize acquisition-aware and physics-informed modeling, multicenter and privacy-preserving collaboration, clinically meaningful validation, and closer integration with neurointerventional workflows. By linking methodological developments with their supporting evidence and translational challenges, this review aims to support the development of more robust and clinically applicable AI methods for cerebrovascular DSA.
zh_abstract: [Physics in medicine and biology] 脑血管疾病仍然是全球死亡和长期残疾的主要原因。数字减影血管造影（DSA）可提供脑血管解剖结构和对比剂动力学的高时空分辨率可视化，并在诊断、介入治疗计划和治疗评估中发挥重要作用。人工智能（AI）已越来越多地应用于脑血管 DSA，但现有证据分散于不同的成像环境、技术任务、数据集和验证策略中。这篇结构化专题综述以 DSA 为中心，概述了二维 DSA、三维旋转血管造影和四维 DSA 中 AI 辅助的脑血管图像分析。来自 Web of Science Core Collection 和主要工程数据库的文献使用预定义的合格标准在标题、摘要和全文层面进行筛选。文献围绕六项相互关联的任务进行组织：图像预处理、血管和病灶分割、图像配准、重建与生成、疾病诊断与检测以及血流动力学分析。综述了代表性的传统方法和基于学习的方法及其数据集、评价指标、验证设计以及可获取的数据或代码资源，特别关注支持证据的优势与局限性。近期研究表明，时空建模、深度学习和图像生成技术的使用日益增多，但临床转化仍受限于小型或单中心数据集、异质性采集方案与评价实践、有限的外部验证和前瞻性验证、模型可解释性以及部署要求。未来工作应强调采集感知和物理知情建模、多中心和隐私保护协作、具有临床意义的验证，以及与神经介入工作流程更紧密的结合。通过将方法学进展与其支持证据和转化挑战相联系，本综述旨在支持开发更稳健、更具临床适用性的脑血管 DSA AI 方法。

title: Weight-Space Programming for Medical Imaging: Do We Still Need Training Data?
zh_title: 医学影像的权重空间编程：不再需要训练数据？
summary: 预印本让大模型直接写出医学图像分类器权重，在7个任务4种模态上与零样本MedSigLIP及常规训练模型比较。
key_points: LLM一次回复直接生成LeNet式网络参数
对照零样本MedSigLIP与Adam训练基线
覆盖胸片、乳腺超声、腹部CT与盆腔MRI
reason: 预印本方法新颖且有明确基线对比，但仅在公开基准上评估，给6分
abstract: Can a large language model (LLM) write the parameters of a medical image classifier from medical knowledge alone, without any training data? Such classifiers normally require labelled images, which are costly and often unavailable. We investigate this question through weight-space programming (WSP), in which an LLM writes or adapts the weights and biases of a neural network directly, without optimisation on training data. Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra each generate the parameters of a small LeNet-style CNN in a single reply, without tool use and without access to any image. We compare these networks against zero-shot MedSigLIP and against the same architecture trained on labels using the Adam optimiser, across 7 classification tasks in four modalities: chest X-ray, breast ultrasound and abdominal CT (all from MedMNIST), and pelvic MRI (SynthUterus). The LLM-written networks perform above chance on all six MedMNIST tasks, with a mean test AUC of 0.719 for Opus and 0.711 for Astra. Both models outperform MedSigLIP on 5 of 6 tasks while using more than 10,000 times fewer parameters. However, the same network trained with Adam on only 256 labelled images achieves a higher AUC on every MedMNIST task (mean AUC 0.828). On SynthUterus, Opus attains an AUC of 0.764, whereas Astra falls below chance (AUC 0.136) owing to a systematic error. These results show that LLMs can write functional medical classifiers, but that they do not yet replace training data. We release the protocol, logs and all generated weights at https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能否仅凭医学知识、在没有任何训练数据的情况下写出医学图像分类器的参数？此类分类器通常需要标注图像，而标注图像成本高昂且常常不可获得。我们通过权重空间编程（WSP）研究这一问题：在该方法中，LLM 直接写出或调整神经网络的权重与偏置，而不在训练数据上进行优化。Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 各自在单次回复中生成一个小型 LeNet 风格 CNN 的参数，不使用工具，也无法访问任何图像。我们在四种模态的 7 个分类任务上，将这些网络与零样本 MedSigLIP 以及使用 Adam 优化器在标签上训练的相同架构进行比较：胸部 X 线、乳腺超声和腹部 CT（均来自 MedMNIST），以及盆腔 MRI（SynthUterus）。LLM 写出的网络在全部六个 MedMNIST 任务上均高于随机水平，Opus 和 Astra 的平均测试 AUC 分别为 0.719 和 0.711。两个模型在 6 个任务中的 5 个上优于 MedSigLIP，同时使用的参数少超过 10,000 倍。然而，相同网络仅使用 256 张标注图像通过 Adam 训练，就在每个 MedMNIST 任务上取得更高的 AUC（平均 AUC 0.828）。在 SynthUterus 上，Opus 达到 AUC 0.764，而 Astra 由于系统性错误而低于随机水平（AUC 0.136）。这些结果表明，LLM 能够写出功能性的医学分类器，但尚不能取代训练数据。我们在 https://github.com/MaximilianLindholz/weight-space-programming-medical 发布协议、日志和所有生成的权重。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: İsmail Palalı; conditions: Pain, Chronic Pain, Health Professions Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: COMPLETED] Physiotherapists need to explain pain to patients in a way that is scientifically accurate, understandable, and non-threatening. Pain neuroscience education (PNE) improves students' pain knowledge, but it is unclear whether this translates into retained ability to explain pain to patients. This randomized controlled trial tested whether adding structured feedback from a large language model (LLM; GPT-5.2 Instant, OpenAI, via the ChatGPT interface) to a standardized four-week PNE programme improves undergraduate physiotherapy students' pain-explanation competence compared with the same programme using standardized expert-developed (non-AI) feedback. title: SkinMind: Equipping Agentic RAG with Human-Inspired Graph Probing for Reliable Dermatology AI
zh_title: SkinMind：面向皮肤科的多模态智能体检索增强框架
summary: 预印本提出SkinMind多模态智能体RAG框架，借图探查工具迭代检索文本与视觉证据以支撑皮肤科判读。
key_points: 编排器与图环境迭代交互完成检索
八类分层图探查工具支持多跳取证
针对皮肤科异质文本与图像证据
reason: 预印本方法有新意，但仅见方法描述、缺乏验证细节，给5分
abstract: Reliable dermatology AI requires access to verifiable evidence distributed across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. However, conventional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically relies on one-shot retrieval from flat corpora, limiting its ability to adapt retrieval granularity, explore multi-hop relations, and integrate multimodal clinical evidence. We introduce SkinMind, a multimodal agentic RAG framework that equips policy models with human-inspired graph probing for autonomous evidence seeking. SkinMind organizes retrieval as an iterative interaction between an orchestrator and a graph environment. Through eight hierarchical graph-probing tools, the orchestrator progressively identifies relevant entities, inspects node-level information, traverses relations and paths, and retrieves source-text and visual evidence. This progressive-disclosure design allows the model to adaptively determine the retrieval modality, exploration direction, and evidence granularity while constructing a query-specific evidence subgraph. To support autonomous graph probing, we construct SkinMind-KG from a 62M-token corpus of dermatology guidelines and textbooks and 423K images, guided by a dermatologist-informed schema and a conflict-resolution mechanism. The resulting graph contains over 1.0M nodes and 2.0M edges, unifying textual, relational, and visual evidence for retrieval. Across six dermatology VQA benchmarks and two policy-model settings, SkinMind improves the average score over direct answering by 8.70 and 8.89 points with GPT-5.4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash, respectively, while consistently outperforming competing RAG methods. Together, SkinMind and SkinMind-KG provide an effective foundation for evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning in dermatology.
zh_abstract: 可靠皮肤病学 AI 需要获取分布于异质文本与视觉来源中的可验证证据。然而，传统检索增强生成（RAG）通常依赖对扁平语料库的一次性检索，限制了其调整检索粒度、探索多跳关系以及整合多模态临床证据的能力。我们提出 SkinMind，一种多模态智能体式 RAG 框架，为策略模型配备受人类启发的图探查能力，以实现自主证据寻求。SkinMind 将检索组织为编排器与图环境之间的迭代交互。通过八种分层图探查工具，编排器逐步识别相关实体、检查节点级信息、遍历关系与路径，并检索源文本与视觉证据。这种渐进披露设计使模型能够在构建查询特定证据子图的同时，自适应地确定检索模态、探索方向与证据粒度。为支持自主图探查，我们基于一个包含 62M token 的皮肤病学指南与教科书语料库以及 423K 张图像构建 SkinMind-KG，并以皮肤病学家知情模式（schema）和冲突解决机制为指导。所得图包含超过 1.0M 个节点和 2.0M 条边，统一文本、关系与视觉证据以供检索。在六个皮肤病学 VQA 基准和两种策略模型设置下，SkinMind 相较于直接回答，在使用 GPT-5.4-mini 和 Gemini-2.5-Flash 时平均分数分别提高 8.70 分和 8.89 分，同时持续优于竞争性 RAG 方法。总之，SkinMind 与 SkinMind-KG 为皮肤病学中基于证据的多模态推理提供了有效基础。

abstract: In clinical datasets, data augmentation is often avoided because it can remove important unusual values, known as outliers, which are important for understanding diseases accurately. However, clinical EEG datasets often suffer from two key limitations: small sample sizes and class imbalance, which significantly reduce classification performance. To overcome these challenges, this study applies generative AI-based data augmentation techniques with a carefully designed hybrid pipeline that effectively enhances performance even on limited EEG data. Using EEG signals from 50 brain stroke patients, we investigate both traditional oversampling methods (SMOTE and ADASYN) and advanced generative models, including WGAN and WGAN-GP. Our proposed pipeline involves preprocessing EEG recordings, extracting comprehensive statistical and frequency-domain features, applying feature reduction, and evaluating multiple machine learning classifiers. Experimental results show that the combination of SelectKBest feature selection, SVM classifier, and WGAN-GP augmentation achieves the highest classification accuracy of 72%, outperforming other methods. This work introduces a novel hybrid approach for EEG-based stroke severity classification, demonstrating that generative augmentation, when integrated properly, can significantly improve performance on small clinical datasets. To the best of our knowledge, this combination of techniques has not been explored before on any dataset, providing a solid foundation for future research in automated EEG-based stroke diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 在临床数据集中，数据增强常被避免，因为它可能去除重要的不寻常值，即异常值，而这些值对于准确理解疾病很重要。然而，临床 EEG 数据集常受两个关键限制：样本量小和类别不平衡，这会显著降低分类性能。为克服这些挑战，本研究应用基于生成式 AI 的数据增强技术，并采用精心设计的混合流程，即使在有限 EEG 数据上也能有效提升性能。我们使用 50 名脑卒中患者的 EEG 信号，研究传统过采样方法（SMOTE 和 ADASYN）以及先进生成模型，包括 WGAN 和 WGAN-GP。我们提出的流程包括预处理 EEG 记录、提取全面的统计与频域特征、应用特征降维，并评估多种机器学习分类器。实验结果表明，SelectKBest 特征选择、SVM 分类器和 WGAN-GP 增强的组合达到最高分类准确率 72%，优于其他方法。这项工作提出了一种用于基于 EEG 的卒中严重程度分类的新颖混合方法，证明生成式增强在适当整合后可显著改善小型临床数据集上的性能。据我们所知，这种技术组合此前尚未在任何数据集上探索过，为未来基于 EEG 的自动化卒中诊断研究提供了坚实基础。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Pancreas Carcinoma, PDAC - Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 50; status: RECRUITING] Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is associated with a poor prognosis, and early detection of pancreatic lesions is of great importance for improving patient outcomes. In this study, whole-body imaging with FDG and FAPI will be used to visualize the early development of pancreatic cancer lesions from multiple perspectives, including glucose metabolism, tumor fibrotic stroma, and integrin receptor expression. Furthermore, leveraging the advantages of four-dimensional dynamic long-axial PET imaging, artificial intelligence-assisted lesion detection and analysis will be performed to characterize lesions and differentiate between benign and malignant lesions. The imaging findings will subsequently be compared with postoperative histopathological results to evaluate the diagnostic performance of the proposed imaging approaches.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：瑞金医院；疾病：胰腺癌，PDAC——胰腺导管腺癌；类型：观察性；入组人数：50；状态：招募中] 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）预后较差，早期发现胰腺病灶对于改善患者结局极为重要。在本研究中，将使用 FDG 和 FAPI 全身成像，从葡萄糖代谢、肿瘤纤维化间质和整合素受体表达等多个角度可视化胰腺癌病灶的早期发展。此外，利用四维动态长轴 PET 成像的优势，将进行人工智能辅助的病灶检测与分析，以表征病灶并区分良性和恶性病灶。随后，将影像学发现与术后组织病理学结果进行比较，以评估所提出的影像学方法的诊断性能。
